arguments.function: async () => {const s=document.querySelector('[data-section="14"]');window.scrollTo(0,s.getBoundingClientRect().top+scrollY+0);for(const image of s.querySelectorAll('img'))if(image.checkVisibility()){image.loading='eager';try{await Promise.race([image.decode(),new Promise((_,reject)=>setTimeout(reject,2000))])}catch(e){}}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));return {number:14,tile:0,height:s.getBoundingClientRect().height};}
